title: Te Kaiwhakaatu Pūmau
intro: Ka huraina he kōrero hohonu, e whakaatu ana i te u tonu o te hapori i te aroaro o te mana tukino nui. Ko tā rātou kōrero he tohu mō te whakapono, ahakoa te patunga tapu nui. E whakamahara ana tēnei kōrero i te mana o te whakapono ki te ārai i te tukino nui.
clues: He rōpū mātou nō rātou te kōrero i roto i tētahi surah poto, kaha, hei whakatūpato mō te whakatoi.
I tūtaki mātou ki tētahi rangatira i hiahia ki te whakakore i tō mātou whakapono ki te Atua Kotahi, te Ariki o te Torona, te Mea Whakamoemititia.
I pāngia mātou e tētahi whakamātautau whakamataku, arā, he poka nui i keria ki roto i te whenua.
I mātakitaki mātou i te hunga whakapono, tae atu ki ngā pēpi, e makahia ana ki roto i te mura ahi i roto i taua poka.
I kanga ō mātou kaiwhakatoi mō ā rātou mahi, i oatitia mai ia ki a mātou he utu nui mō tō mātou u tonu.
Ko te ngana a te rangatira ki te tineia tō mātou whakapono i whakapūmau ake i tō mātou tūranga hei mātārai i te aroaro o Allah, ko ia te kaiwhakaatu o ngā mea katoa.

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakaorangia mātou e te merekara
I tutuki te matekiri me te Pararaiha
I marara noa atu i ngā whenua
I hoatu he taonga nui ki a rātou
outcome.answer: I tutuki te matekiri me te Pararaiha

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
